definitions.text_en: Gudja (a city and local council of the Southern Region, Malta)
definitions.text_mt: Belt u kunsill lokali tar-Reġjun Nofsinhar, Malta

usage_examples.mt: Gudja hija waħda mill-eqdem irħula f'Malta.
usage_examples.en: Gudja is one of the oldest villages in Malta.

usage_examples.mt: Il-festa ta' Gudja ssir f'Ġunju ta' kull sena.
usage_examples.en: The feast of Gudja is held in June every year.

definitions.text_mt: Poligonu b'gugol (10^100) naħa (ortografija alternattiva ta' gugligonu)

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma gugilgonu hija varjant ortografiku ta' gugligonu.
usage_examples.en: The word gugilgonu is an orthographic variant of gugligonu.

definitions.text_mt: Poligonu b'gugol (10^100) naħa

usage_examples.mt: Gugligonu huwa poligonu b'numru astronomiku ta' naħat.
usage_examples.en: A googolgon is a polygon with an astronomical number of sides.

definitions.text_mt: Ħuta tat-tip Argyrosomus regius
Ħuta tat-tip Umbrina cirrosa
Ħuta tat-tip Sciaena umbra

usage_examples.mt: Il-gurbell huwa ħuta popolari mal-kosta Maltija.
usage_examples.en: The meagre is a popular fish off the Maltese coast.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjieda spiss jaqbdu l-gurbell f'ibħra Maltin.
usage_examples.en: Fishermen often catch meagre in Maltese waters.

usage_examples.mt: Illum qbadna gurbell ta' ħames kilogrammi.
usage_examples.en: Today we caught a meagre weighing five kilograms.

definitions.text_mt: Argyrosomus regius (sinonimu ta' gurbell)

usage_examples.en: Gurbell rar is a synonym of gurbell.

definitions.text_mt: Korp eżekuttiv li jamministra stat, nazzjon jew pajjiż

usage_examples.en: The new government announced important reforms.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gvern qed jaħdem biex itejjeb is-saħħa pubblika.
usage_examples.en: The government is working to improve public health.

definitions.text_mt: Tmexxija jew amministrazzjoni ta' stat jew organizzazzjoni (nom verbali ta' ggverna)

usage_examples.mt: Il-gvernar tal-pajjiż jeħtieġ ħila u dedikazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The governing of the country requires skill and dedication.
Good governance is essential for stability.

definitions.text_mt: Kunflitt armat fuq skala kbira bejn stati, nazzjonijiet jew gruppi

usage_examples.en: The war left much destruction behind it.
Peace is better than war.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna mħarrġa biex tiġġieled fil-gwerra, speċjalment b'mod professjonali

usage_examples.mt: Il-gwerrier kellu armatura qawwija u xabla.
usage_examples.en: The warrior had strong armour and a sword.
Stories of warriors are popular with the people.

definitions.text_mt: Gwerra mhux konvenzjonali mwettqa minn gruppi żgħar irregolari (ortografija alternattiva ta' gwerrilla)

usage_examples.en: The guerrilla war lasted for many years.

definitions.text_mt: Gwerra mhux konvenzjonali mwettqa minn gruppi żgħar irregolari, tipikament kontra forza militari akbar

usage_examples.en: Guerrilla warfare was an effective strategy for the rebels.

usage_examples.mt: Ħafna gruppi użaw il-gwerrilla matul l-istorja.
usage_examples.en: Many groups used guerrilla warfare throughout history.

definitions.text_mt: Jisparixxi, ma jibqax jidher (ortografija alternattiva ta' għeb)

usage_examples.en: The sun disappeared behind the sea.
The cat disappeared into the night.

definitions.text_en: to adore, to worship, to serve
definitions.text_mt: Kellu qima lejn Alla jew divinità u qeda b'ubbidjenza

usage_examples.en: The people used to worship the ancient gods.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa għabad lil Alla b'qalbu kollha.
usage_examples.en: He worshipped God with all his heart.

definitions.text_en: to load (put something on a means of transportation)
definitions.text_mt: Poġġa merkanzija jew tagħbija fuq mezz ta' trasport

definitions.text_en: to load (put a burden on something)
definitions.text_mt: Tella' piż jew responsabbiltà fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa
Qarraq b'xi ħadd, iġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa falza

usage_examples.en: The workers loaded the crate onto the truck.
They loaded me with a lot of work today.

usage_examples.mt: Għabbni meta qalli li kien sinjur.
usage_examples.en: He deceived me when he told me he was rich.

definitions.text_mt: Iddetermina l-piż ta' xi ħaġa permezz ta' miżien
Kesa b'saff ta' trab jew partiċelli fini

usage_examples.en: The shopkeeper weighs the vegetables before selling them.
The wind covered everything with dust.

definitions.text_mt: Qaddej jew ilsir (ortografija alternattiva ta' għabid)

usage_examples.mt: Huwa kien għabd fidil ta' sidu.
usage_examples.en: He was a faithful servant to his master.

definitions.text_en: sunset, dusk, twilight (period between daylight and darkness)
definitions.text_mt: Ħin tal-ġurnata bejn inżul ix-xemx u d-dlam

usage_examples.en: I like to go for a walk at dusk.
Dusk arrives early in winter.

definitions.text_mt: Qaddej jew ilsir (persuna li taħdem għal ħaddieħor jew li mhix ħielsa)

usage_examples.mt: Il-kaptan kellu ħafna għabid jaħdmu għalih.
usage_examples.en: The captain had many slaves working for him.
The servant worked hard all day.

definitions.text_mt: Trab (partiċelli fini u niexfa ta' materjal solidu)

usage_examples.en: There is a lot of dust on the shelf.
Wipe the dust off the table.

definitions.text_mt: Muntun ta' età ta' sena (ibro qasla)

usage_examples.en: The farmer bought a yearling ram for his flock.

usage_examples.mt: L-għabur huwa muntun żgħir ta' sena.
usage_examples.en: A għabur is a young ram of one year.

definitions.text_mt: Avverbju li jindika li xi ħaġa tkompli sseħħ sal-mument preżenti
Avverbju li jindika li xi ħaġa għadha ma seħħitx iżda hija mistennija

usage_examples.en: Is there still milk?
She has not arrived home yet.

definitions.text_en: only used in għad li (“ it is said that ”)
definitions.text_mt: Użat biss fl-espressjoni 'għad li' biex tintroduċi dikjarazzjoni jew rapportaġġ

usage_examples.mt: Għad li mhux se jiġi llum.
usage_examples.en: It is said that he will not come today.
It is said that the meeting has been postponed.

definitions.text_mt: Avverbju li jindika l-jum wara llum, fil-ġejjieni immedjat

usage_examples.en: See you tomorrow morning.
Tomorrow we will have an important meeting.

definitions.text_mt: Drawwa (prattika jew imġiba regolari u ripetuta)

usage_examples.mt: Kellu l-għada li jmur jimxi kull filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: He had the habit of going for a walk every morning.

usage_examples.mt: Din l-għada ilha miegħu snin twal.
usage_examples.en: This habit has been with him for many years.

definitions.text_mt: Rabja jew korla qawwija (nom verbali ta' għadab)

usage_examples.mt: L-għadab tiegħu kien evidenti għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: His anger was evident to everyone.
Learn to control your anger.
